title: Rose Mulmul Dress
short_description: Soft mulmul cotton with an easy, feminine silhouette.
long_description: A breathable, thoughtfully finished dress designed for relaxed days and intimate occasions. Enquire for available colours and customization.
notes: Typical lead time: 10–14 days. Custom sizing available.

title: Handwoven Ivory Saree
short_description: An understated drape celebrating texture and natural elegance.
long_description: A timeless saree for those who love subtle texture and versatile styling. Ask Priya about blouse customization and current textile availability.

title: Indigo Everyday Kurti
short_description: An effortless kurti made for repeat wear.
long_description: A comfortable everyday silhouette with a handcrafted feel. Available in select textile variations and customizable to your measurements.
notes: Lead time varies by fabric availability.

title: Noir Silk Kaftan
short_description: A fluid, floor-skimming kaftan cut for effortless, breezy elegance.
long_description: Generous drape, a relaxed silhouette and hand-finished edges make this kaftan equally suited to resort days and evening ease. Enquire about fabric options and length adjustments.
notes: Typical lead time: 10–14 days. One-size relaxed fit with tie-waist customization available.

title: Crochet Bloom Top
short_description: A playful handcrafted crochet layer with delicate texture.
long_description: A lightweight crochet piece designed to layer over dresses, camisoles and sarees. Enquire for colour options and made-to-measure requests.

title: Custom Occasion Ensemble
short_description: A one-to-one custom design for your occasion and personality.
long_description: Work with Priya to develop a personalized ensemble around your occasion, preferred silhouette, textile and styling direction. Final pricing depends on fabric, detailing and complexity.
notes: Consultation required. Typical lead time: 3–5 weeks.
